Say you notice an acquaintance has feelings for you. How do you distinguish between a harmless crush that won't go anywhere and someone who may make unwanted advances or stalk you?

I'm not a girl, nor am I a stalker, all I can say is if this acquaintance is a good person they will understand when you lay down the fact that you're not interested in them. If you don't want to be blunt then just hint about it, they'll eventually get it.

nor am I a stalker

Nice try, stalker!

In all seriousness though, you're right that reminding them I'm happily taken and not looking is a really good strategy to keep a crush from getting out of hand. I'll make sure to keep it in mind.

I would say it would weigh on how often the person persists... Does the person seem pushy and know too much of your business? Does the person appear randomly in places that you hangout and where they shouldn't be?

I have two things on my mind with this question: a specific person and the general case that may pop up in the future.

I couldn't imagine this specific person being a stalker. Not at all pushy, doesn't seem to know a bunch from cyber stalking, and never follows me around. With this person I just worry about a crush getting out of hand and maybe turning in to unwanted advances.

They started with a couple small comments that seemed odd. Saying I was exactly like this person they'd wanted to sleep with and marry but they weren't able to land then commenting that they bet they're very similar to my SO because we get along so well and are so much alike. Lately they've been outright telling me they really enjoy our conversations and like spending time together. Things that you normally just imply.

I'm just getting uncomfortable because I had another case of someone I thought was a friend start coming on to me hard and creating drama/trouble with my SO. I'm hoping to learn to tell if a crush will be trouble it not.
Being that it makes you uncomfortable it is probably not good. Try to be upfront and say that your boundaries have been crossed. Follow your instincts!

Thanks for taking the time to reply. I was so wrong about it the last time (false negative) that I doubt my instincts. I worry I'm just paranoid now and over-correcting in my sensitivity.

I'm hoping to get grounded with some signs to watch for or rules of thumb to validate or check my gut feeling.
